name: What common renovations add the most value to a rental property?

mainEntity.name: What common renovations add the most value to a rental property?

acceptedAnswer.text: Renovations that offer the best return on investment for rental properties often focus on durability and broad appeal. Kitchen and bathroom updates are consistently top performers, as they are high-traffic areas. Consider modernizing fixtures, refreshing cabinets, or replacing worn countertops. Flooring upgrades to durable options like LVP or tile, and a fresh coat of neutral paint throughout the property, also significantly enhance attractiveness and perceived value to potential tenants. Prioritizing functional and aesthetic improvements that withstand tenant use is key.
acceptedAnswer.description: Kitchen and bathroom updates, durable flooring, and fresh paint generally add the most value to a rental property by appealing to a wider tenant base and standing up to wear.
